lines.en: I show up at the cafe to find Haruka and Rin sitting at a table near the door.
The girl manning the counter is someone I haven’t seen before so, not wanting to involve myself with anyone new, I decide to intrude on the conversation between these two.
Judging by the clipboard, however, it appears that I may have suddenly walked into a relatively important discussion.
Whoops.
: Hey! Is it Sensei-time already?
: Yes, it appears it is Sensei-time.
: Sensei-time isn’t a thing. Please don’t say that anymore.
: Sensei-time.
: Anyway, what are you two doing over here? Shouldn’t you be working right now?
: I was actually just doing Rin’s performance review for the quarter.
: Yup-yup. And, news-flash, turns out I’m pretty awesome. Who would have thought?
: Not me considering you have only given me what I’ve actually ordered maybe once or twice since I started coming here.
: That’s just cause you’re special. Tell him, Haruka.
: This is news to me, actually. I’m going to dock a few points from your review so I don’t have to give you a raise.
: Please do better in the future for the sake of the company.
: Are you bein’ for real right now?
: Of course not. You can keep making whatever you want for him as long as he continues to keep doing nothing about it.
: Wow, the service here has really gone downhill lately.
: Like Rin said, you’re special.
: Plus, we’re friends now.
: I don’t have to be nice to you anymore now that I know you’re here for the girls instead of the coffee.
: Hey wait a second, how come you two are acting super close all of a sudden?
: When did this happen?
: In my defense, I am not acting any different than normal. This is all Haruka.
: There’s no need to be jealous, Rin. I’m sure you still see him more often than I do.
: Well...probably.
: And I’m not jealous. I’m just surprised.
: I could have sworn you were a loner, Haruka. I didn’t even know you talked to anybody other than all of us at the cafe.
: Oh. Well thank you for reminding me of how incredibly lonely I am, Rin. I appreciate that.
: No sweat! This is just our thing, isn’t it?
: You tease me about not being able to reach the syrup bottles on the top shelf and I tease you about going years without getting laid.
Don’t do it, Haruka.
Don’t say anything.
: Hm? Isn’t this the part where you come up with some sarcastic remark or something?
: We’re supposed to go back and forth right about now and-
: Oh my God, you fucked my boss!
: Dude!
: Hahaha...
: Don’t you think I would have told you if something like that happened, Rin?
: No, actually. You kind of have a track record of going behind my back with people I know now, so yeah.
: That’s...
I decide against prying anymore into that side of things at the risk of further-destroying my relationship with Rin.
: Well, yeah. But Haruka really only gets quiet like this when she’s trying to hide something.
: Plus, I already told you she thought you were cute and stuff a while back, so it’s not impossible for something like that to happen.
: I’m kind of surprised by Haruka, though.
: I know you haven’t seen your husband in a while but I didn’t think you’d crack under the pressure that-
: I didn’t crack.
: Nothing is going on between your teacher and me.
: I was just messing with you since I know you two are close.
: Well...
: That’s kind of a relief. But now I also feel really bad about accusing you of something like that.
: You should probably get a little better at hiding things if you want to-
: Get back to work, Rin.
: I was just leaving.
: Sorry.
Rin quickly ducks away from the table, taking her notebook and coffee with her before disappearing into the back room.
: Hey. You leave my sex-life out of this.
: Do you have any idea how satisfying it will actually be when he comes back from the war?
: Nope. I’m an innocent virgin barista so I have no idea how satisfying it is in the first place.
: Oh my God...Why am I even talking to you about this?
: Sensei, I’m sorry my boss doesn’t feel the same way about you as you feel about her.
: Thankfully, the girl I’ve been after for literally years is, so you’ll have to settle for fucking a cute [teenager] instead of a voluptuous older woman.
: Sorry for your loss.
: Rin...
: There are plenty of other fish in the sea, though. I’m sure you’ll catch one eventually.
: Heck, you might even have a shot with me if you keep trying. It only makes sense to fall for someone you keep spending time with, right?
: Sure there’s the added issue of me still thinking penises are kind of scary, but you know how it is.
: I thought I did until that last part. Now I’m just back to being confused.
: It is what it is, homie.
: And on that note, our review is now complete.
: Get back to work, Rin.
: Aye aye, Captain Haruka!
: Have fun not having sex with my teacher!
: And you have fun cleaning the bathrooms. Leave.
: Roger that! Love you, bye!
Rin quickly ducks away from the table, taking her notebook and coffee with her before disappearing into the back room.
: I have to commend you for being able to put up with her for this long every weekend.
: You have to put up with her too, don’t you? Isn’t she in your class?
: She is, but she’s a little different in[school] than she is here.
: She seems happier in the cafe. Kind of like she admires you or something like that.
: Me? Why would she admire me?
: All I do is work and talk about what shows I’ve been watching on Netflix lately.
: I’m kind of insanely boring if you take out the part about me dressing up as a cat and riding you on occasion.
: But that’s my favorite part about you.
: I still kind of can’t believe I was drunk enough to do something like that.
: Maki really manages to bring the worst out of me sometimes.
: Was it Maki’s idea to invite me over?
: Well, no. But-
: Then don’t blame her for what happened.
: You made a decision and you followed through with it. She just happened to be there for it.
: You’re right. I need to accept responsibility for my actions.
: I’ve just gone so long without being...involved in someone new that I kind of forget how it works at times.
: But, in my defense-
: Maki is fucking hot.
: I can’t believe you made me wait an extra 24 hours to hook up with you two after the Halloween party at the bar.
: And I can’t believe you went upstairs with Sara without inviting the two of us.
: Sara didn’t want you to come.
: I can’t believe you didn’t keep pushing for it to happen. Jerk.
: Didn’t you pass out within the next 30 minutes anyway?
: Yes. Out of disappointment.
: Poor Maki.
: More like poor Haruka.
: Kind of degrading listening to your best friend get fucked by the guy you’re into while you sit downstairs and get drunk.
: You heard us?
I guess that makes sense given how old the building Sara lives in is.
That’s kind of concerning in the event of anyone else ever being downstairs while...things are happening, though.
: Of course I heard you. That girl is even louder than I am.
: Mmm...I don’t think that’s true.
: I’m louder than that?
: Do you not realize how into it you get, Haruka?
: I had no idea...
: My neighbors...Do you think they, you know, hear us?
: I’d be shocked if they didn’t, to be honest.
: Oh God...
: Something wrong?
: A lot is wrong. I don’t want to talk about it here, though.
: Apparently I’m a walking megaphone so I don’t want the girls to hear us talking about how loud I am when you fuck me.
: Right.
: Maki might be super hot, but I don't really think she could please me the same you can.
: If there is any woman who can do just that, I'm positive it's Maki. Have you seen the arsenal of sex toys at her shop?
: You’re right. That does sound incredibly lonely.
: It’s even lonelier when I eat an entire pint of ice cream and cry myself to sleep afterward.
: Such is the life of a woman who lives alone.
: Sara lives alone and I doubt she cries herself to sleep every night.
: Yes but Sara also keeps a dildo on the shelf next to her bed so she is clearly a force to be reckoned with.
: Yeah, good point.
: But anyway, I do think Rin sees you as some sort of role model. At least that’s how I’d see you in her position.
: People like looking up to more successful people in the same position as them.
: And even if you’re lonely, you’re still doing something with your life.
: Did you really come here just to lecture me?
: No. I came here to see you. So this is supposed to be the part where you start feeling a little less lonely.
: You’re here to see me despite having a girl like, half my age and four times prettier than me two steps away from just...biting the bullet and admitting her love for you?
: Rin doesn’t love me, Haruka.
: Oh please. She looks at you differently than pretty much every other guy that’s ever come in here.
: She swings both ways, doesn’t she? I’m sure she’d be more than willing to embark on a journey of sexual exploration with you under the right circumstances.
: It would be easier for me to believe that if I didn’t finger the girl she’s in love with.
: You fingered the cute blonde girl who comes in here all the time?!
: No. You never heard that.
: No! I did totally just hear that!
: How did that even happen?!
: Oh, please. Ever since the blonde girl rejected her, she’s only ever really talked about you.
: Probably just a coincidence. I doubt Rin sees me as anything more than like, an older brother or father figure right now.
: Doesn’t mean she doesn’t want to try experimenting a little bit, though~
: She’s a [teenage]girl. She’s curious. I was the same when I was her age.
: You really think she’s never entertained the thought of fooling around with the same guy who hangs out with her in her room all the time?
: Come on, man. You know better than that.
: You’ve put a lot of thought into this, huh?
: When you’ve got employees as cute as her, you sometimes can’t help but think about things like that.
: I’m starting to think you might be just as into [teenage]girls as me, Haruka.
: Me? Nooooo.
: I just staff my cafe with inexperienced, cute girls because they make the best employees.
: Of course I’m into them. Everyone loves cute girls, Sensei. Just because I’m a girl doesn’t mean I’m an exception to that.
: I mean, I’m all about this. But you should probably be careful acting on anything at the risk of getting sued one day.
: Oh, come on. I’m a degenerate but I’m not a bad person.
She says, despite actively cheating on her husband.
: It’s one thing for me to be attracted to girls like Rin or Molly-
: Molly, too?
: Or Rin’s friend Futaba.
: Or Molly’s friend...Tsuneyo, I think?
Oh my God. She’s just as bad as me.
: But just wanting to mess around with all of them doesn’t mean I actually would, you know?
: Unless they offered. Because in that case, I absolutely would.
: I’m glad we became friends, Haruka.
: I feel like our relationship has moved forward several steps today.
: Then come hang out with me again soon. As friends.
: We’ll sit on my couch and I can show you some of the stuff I watch when I’m thinking about how lonely I am.
: That sounds absolutely delightful.
Not.
: Sweet. Maybe I’ll invite Rin, too? Who knows?
: You’re going to invite a [teenage]girl to your house to watch movies with you and another older guy?
: Totally not suspicious at all.
: And hanging out in her dorm isn’t?
: Touché.
: Oh well. Do whatever you want.
: If I do whatever I want, I’ll end up in jail.
: I will exercise the same amount of restraint I always do, and the two of us will forget this conversation ever happened.
: Deal?
: Deal.
No deal.
I can’t just forget finding out that Haruka is lusting after her entire cafe staff and...everyone her cafe staff knows and...
Probably just everyone in general.
But I guess after going years without having sex, you start getting desperate.
To think Haruka would be permanently psychologically damaged by something like this, though...
That’s just so sad.
: Well, I guess I’ll get out of your hair then.
: Sounds good. I need to start actually working again anyway.
: Call me soon, though. Got it?
: Yup.
: See you later, Haruka.
: Talk to you soon!
I exit the cafe without buying anything.
Not because I wasn’t thirsty, but because I’d inadvertently gotten an erection after finding out about Haruka’s hidden infatuation with [teenage]girls and didn’t want to scare any of the part-timers.
Eventually, the erection fades and I am free to get on with my day the way I normally do.
I’ll have to call Haruka some night in the near future and see if I can do anything else to quell that undying loneliness of hers.
Haruka’s affection has increased to [haruka_love]!
